attribs.name: repeating_traits_-MOS1bZCKsJNEHcbRgup_description
attribs.current: You are skilled in stealth and surviving far from the streets of a city, allowing you to scout ahead of your companions during expeditions. Rogues who embrace this archetype are at home in the wilderness and among barbarians and rangers, and many Scouts serve as the eyes and ears of war bands. Ambusher, spy, bounty hunter—these are just a few of the roles that Scouts assume as they range the world.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-MOS1bZWeFptj8p1MHab_description
attribs.current: Starting at 3rd level, you are difficult to pin down during a fight. You can move up to half your speed as a reaction when an enemy ends its turn within 5 feet of you. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-MOS1bZica2UmjjYzJz9_description
attribs.current: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain proficiency in the Nature and Survival skills if you don't already have it. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of those proficiencies.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-MOS1lekbOQkoszNtVgP_description
attribs.current: Although elves reach physical maturity at about the same age as humans, the elven understanding of adulthood goes beyond physical growth to encompass worldly experience. An elf typically claims adulthood and an adult name around the age of 100 and can live to be 750 years old.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-MOS1lepgG5hTec1F9j6_description
attribs.current: Elves love freedom, variety, and self-expression, so they lean strongly toward the gentler aspects of chaos. They value and protect others' freedom as well as their own, and they are more often good than not.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-MOS1lesC6tpGaNKK9g4_description
attribs.current: Elves range from under 5 to over 6 feet tall and have slender builds. Your size is Medium.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-MOS1levdCgDwEZuxQis_description
attribs.current: Accustomed to twilit forests and the night sky, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-MOS1lezJEbadqihhliy_description
attribs.current: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-MOS1lf29jbjg7fy1x1L_description
attribs.current: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-MOS1lf7-k8O3D9Kea5n_description
attribs.current:
Elves don't need to sleep. Instead, they meditate deeply, remaining semiconscious, for 4 hours a day. (The Common word for such meditation is "trance.") While meditating, you can dream after a fashion; such dreams are actually mental exercises that have become reflexive through years of practice. After resting in this way, you gain the same benefit that a human does from 8 hours of sleep.

If you meditate during a long rest, you finish the rest after only 4 hours. You otherwise obey all the rules for a long rest; only the duration is changed.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-MOS1lfBeLuEMxNBRDQE_description
attribs.current: You can speak, read, and write Common and Elvish. Elvish is fluid, with subtle intonations and intricate grammar. Elven literature is rich and varied, and their songs and poems are famous among other races. Many bards learn their language so they can add Elvish ballads to their repertoires.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-MOS1lfEyl1ZfWOn-Pel_description
attribs.current: You have proficiency with the spear, trident, light crossbow, and net.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-MOS1lfIqWNWUPgWiGfO_description
attribs.current: You have a swimming speed of 30 feet, and you can breathe air and water.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-MOS1lfNYpIahn7muIBq_description
attribs.current: Using gestures and sounds, you can communicate simple ideas with any beast that has an innate swimming speed.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-MOS1lfS9VFBkwyw8RR1_description
attribs.current: You can speak, read, and write Aquan.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-MOS3BcGpKc3AxmoIpdw_description
attribs.current:
You have uncanny aim. You gain the following benefits:

- Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

- Whenever you have advantage on an attack roll, you can reroll one of the dice once.

attribs.name: repeating_inventory_-MOS5DpjCHPJBW3Zl4HE_itemcontent
attribs.current:
Range. A weapon that can be used to make a ranged attack has a range shown in parentheses after the ammunition or thrown property. The range lists two numbers. The first is the weapon's normal range in feet, and the second indicates the weapon's maximum range. When attacking a target beyond normal range, you have disadvantage on the attack roll. You can't attack a target beyond the weapon's long range.

Ammunition. You can use a weapon that has the ammunition property to make a ranged attack only if you have ammunition to fire from the weapon. Each time you attack with the weapon, you expend one piece of ammunition. Drawing the ammunition from a quiver, case, or other container is part of the attack. Loading a one-handed weapon requires a free hand. At the end of the battle, you can recover half your expended ammunition by taking a minute to search the battlefield.

If you use a weapon that has the ammunition property to make a melee attack, you treat the weapon as an improvised weapon. A sling must be loaded to deal any damage when used in this way.

Two-Handed. This weapon requires two hands to use. This property is relevant only when you attack with the weapon, not when you simply hold it.

attribs.name: repeating_inventory_-MOS5DpjCHPJBW3Zl4HE_itemmodifiers
attribs.current: Item Type: range, Damage: 1d6, Damage Type: piercing, Range: 80/320

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-MPoFectYvJfKEH3dBGF_description
attribs.current: You know and have met any number of powerful people across the land—and some of them might even remember you. You might be able to wrangle minor assistance from a major figure in the campaign, at the DM's discretion. Additionally, the common folk treat you with deference, and your heritage and the stories you tell might be good for a free meal or a place to sleep.

attribs.name: personality_traits
attribs.current: I'm used to the very best in life, and that's a hard habit to break.

attribs.name: ideals
attribs.current: Peace. Those who can find or make peace in the chaotic world around them have everything. (Lawful)

attribs.name: bonds
attribs.current: Despite their absences, my famous parent was kind and generous. I love them and want to make them proud.

attribs.name: flaws
attribs.current: My best days are behind me. Ahead lies only toil, pain, and death.
